 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

In this appeal the appellant is challenging the judgment and award passed in LAC.No.8/2013 on the
file of the Senior Civil Judge, Kumta sitting at Ankola (for short, the 'Reference Court').
2. The lan
d was acquired for Konkan Railway Project in terms of Section 4(1) under the Land Acquisition Act, 1896 notification dated 30.01.2008.

The properties are situated at Bole Village,
Ankola Taluk.
The Reference Court has determined compensation at Rs.18,745/- per gunta with consequent benefits.

3. The Division Bench of this Court in MFA.No.23783/2011 connected with MFA.No.21971/2010 has determined market value of Rs.11,500/- per gunta for lands in Bole Village, Ankola Taluk i.e., in respect of land acquired for Sea Bird Project and acquisition was in the year 1986.
The Reference Court has granted 3% escalation for every year starting from 1986 and arrived at a valuation of Rs.18,745/-.
The similar method was adopted by this Court in other cases and one of such cases is MFA.No.21998/2010.
It is also to be noticed that similar method is adopted in MFA.Nos.21990/2010 and 22001/2010 decided by this Court.
Accordingly, this Court does not find any merit in the appeal filed by the appellant who is questioning the enhancement made by the Reference Court.

4. For the reasons recorded above, this Court is of the view that there is no merit in the appeal,
accordingly, the appeal is dismissed.
5. The appellant shall deposit the amount within 6 weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.

Sd/-
